Smooth every image with a Gaussian kernel.

Blurs each image with a kernel_size x kernel_size Gaussian of the given sigma, edges reflected (torchvision gaussian_blur), in training, validation and test.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Preprocessing](../categories/preprocessing.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `ImageGaussianBlur` |
| Search words | image, blur, gaussian, smooth |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Input** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Images [H, W, C] in [0, 1], after Resize |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Output** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Images, same shape |

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Kernel size | `kernel_size` | Integer | `5` | `>0` | The run | Odd kernel width; kernel_size / 2 must be below both image sides. |
| Sigma | `sigma` | Number | `1.0` | `>0` | The run | Gaussian standard deviation in pixels. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | No: Image Gaussian Blur is a training image transform: the image batcher runs it on the ArrayFire device between Resize and Normalize; PipelineExecutor image transforms are not implemented |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a preprocessing step |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Usage

```text
Resize -> Image Gaussian Blur -> Normalize -> Conv2D
```

```text
Runs in training, validation and test; the shape stays the same.
```

## Tips

- Removes fine noise; large kernels also remove detail the model may need.
